pages.title: Hunger Value
pages.text: Maids have an independent Hunger value from 0 to 100, starting at 50.$(br2)$(li)0–9: Starving$(li)10–25: Very Hungry$(li)26–40: Hungry$(li)41–74: Normal$(li)75–90: Full$(li)91–100: Overfed

pages.title: Eating & Sleeping
pages.text: Hunger decreases over time. A maid searches her own inventory for food and, when very hungry and empty-handed, may ask another maid with the same master. Hunger does not decrease while she sleeps.

pages.title: Too Low or Too High
pages.text: Very low Hunger causes starvation damage, while overeating can also have negative effects. An injured maid may spend Hunger to recover health, so prepare food before long assignments.
